plan.summary: Deep house: M3 drives a rounded, kick-ducked bassline while M2 answers with electric-piano chords-in-motion and tram 52 plucks a dotted-echo hook over a soft night-bus pad. Try opening the keys filter for brightness, raising the hook's delay send for more echo, or slowing the bass to half speed for a sparser groove.

Hypnotic techno: U5 runs an acid line through the analog ladder filter under a looping two-bar U9 stab with dub echoes, while an S-Bahn drone breathes underneath. Try raising the acid filterQ for more squelch, lengthening the stab's delay feedback, or giving the ride more presence by raising the drum level.

Lo-fi: a warm metro-B piano figure leads over an upright-bass walk on metro C and a nylon-guitar answer from tram 24, with a lazy kick and rim. Try lowering the piano filter for a dustier tape sound, raising the guitar's reverb send, or slowing the bass to half speed for more space.

Bright downtempo: metro M2 rings out FM bells in Lydian over a warm bus-964 bass, a harp answer from tram 4H and a slow 300-bus pad, held together by a soft half-time kick. Try raising the bell modulationIndex for more shimmer, increasing the pad's reverb send, or bringing in the ride for more motion.

Classic house: a two-bar organ stab on the 7 express answers a punchy electric bass on the G over a full kit, with a piano figure from the A and a ping-pong echo. Try raising the organ's delay send, slowing the piano to half speed for space, or deepening the bass sidechain for more pump.

Dub techno: a filtered chord stab from tram 4 dissolves into long dotted echoes over a deep sine bass on tram 10 and a slow lake-side drone from the S18. Try raising the stab's delay feedback, opening its filter for brightness, or adding a touch more reverb to the drums.

Synthwave: metro M1 sings a wide saw lead over a pumping octave bass on bus 105, a kick-ducked tram-22 pad and a tram-11 arpeggio, driven by a big backbeat. Try opening the lead filter, raising its delay send for more lift, or lowering the arp level so the lead has more room.

Melodic techno with a classical accent: a cello line on the U4 carries the hook over a pulsing U3 bass, a violin pad from tram 52 and a rolling FM arp on tram 42. Try raising the cello's reverb send, opening the arp filter for more sparkle, or deepening the bass sidechain.
